title: Grand Hospitality Complex
description: A landmark hospitality destination blending contemporary Indian aesthetics with world-class guest experiences. The design celebrates local materiality while delivering international standards of comfort and elegance.

chapters.title: Exterior Vision
chapters.text: The facade commands the skyline with layered terraces, deep overhangs, and locally sourced stone — a contemporary interpretation of Maharashtra's architectural heritage.

chapters.title: Grand Entrance
chapters.text: A double-height lobby welcomes guests through a procession of light, water, and crafted timber — setting the tone for the experience within.

chapters.title: Interior Narrative
chapters.text: Warm terracotta tones, brass accents, and handwoven textiles create intimate spaces that feel both luxurious and deeply rooted in place.

chapters.title: Material Details
chapters.text: Every junction, every joint tells a story of craftsmanship — from custom metalwork to artisanal plaster finishes developed with local masons.

chapters.title: Night Presence
chapters.text: Strategic lighting transforms the building into a beacon of hospitality — a glowing landmark visible across the Sangli skyline.

title: Courtyard Residence
description: A private family home organized around a central courtyard, balancing Vastu principles with open, light-filled contemporary living.

title: Urban Villa
description: Compact urban living reimagined — vertical gardens, rooftop terrace, and seamless indoor-outdoor transitions on a tight city plot.

title: Retail & Office Complex
description: Mixed-use development with ground-floor retail and upper-level office spaces, designed for maximum visibility and natural ventilation.

title: Boutique Interior Suite
description: Bespoke interior design featuring custom furniture, curated art, and a material palette drawn from the Western Ghats landscape.

title: Educational Campus Block
description: A learning environment designed around natural light, cross-ventilation, and flexible classroom configurations for evolving pedagogies.

title: Hillside Retreat
description: A weekend retreat perched on the Sahyadri foothills — cantilevered decks, panoramic glazing, and locally quarried basalt stone.

title: Hospitality Lounge
description: An intimate dining and lounge space with dramatic ceiling heights, custom lighting design, and artisanal wall treatments.
